purpose: Tracks legacy data problems that must be migrated before mass content production.

items.problem: Legacy file contains multiple top-level arrays and repeats food_001.
items.action: Parse and migrate into canonical dishes data; do not expand this legacy file.

items.problem: Legacy file closes the initial array and continues with additional ingredient objects.
items.action: Normalize into one canonical ingredient array before adding production-scale content.

items.problem: At least one recipe uses an ingredient id whose embedded name does not match the ingredient registry, e.g. recipe_001 uses ing_003 as chicken while legacy ingredients identify ing_003 as beef.
items.action: Resolve by canonical ingredient id, then validate all recipe foreign keys automatically.

items.problem: Legacy recipes mix ids such as ing_009 with free-form ids such as rice, egg, pork and sugar.
items.action: Create migration aliases only after each legacy token is mapped to one canonical ingredient id.

items.problem: Content is currently spread across src/data, data, food, staff, competitor, customer and Android-specific sources.
items.action: Treat src/data/content and src/data/rules as future canonical sources and migrate legacy sources incrementally.
